description: Sends a saved draft to approved developers. It works only for a draft this connection saved in the last 30 minutes, and each person can send only a few per day. The person receives an email copy with a link to cancel. Nothing is charged. The optional text is compared with the saved draft, and nothing is sent if it differs.

task_id.description: The draft to send: the task_id that ask_human_developer returned.

text.description: The exact saved text, to confirm what is being sent. If it differs from the saved draft, nothing is sent.

name: send_request
title: Send a request to developers
